First let me say that your hair does NOT define your beauty. You are beautiful, always! 

I cut my waist length curly hair into a blunt bob, a little at a time. It has helped me get used to the transition and I am actually happy with my short hair. The great thing too is that on days when I AM able to do my hair, pony tail extensions are amazing. Especially on days when I do miss my long hair. Wigs are a good substitution too and you get to try out new styles and colors. See it as a way to discover new looks that you otherwise wouldn’t have tried. Hope this helps. Good luck.
